input.label: Exact VM name or ID (* = all)

div.p: Trace a VM through creation, changes and removal. Name-only identities can split after a rename or merge reused names; prefer VM IDs. Last-state rows only use completed state-changing events within this time window.

search.query: `vmware_vision_audit` | `vmware_vision_unique` | search vcenter=$vc|s$ | where $vm|s$="*" OR lower(vm_name)=lower($vm|s$) OR vm_id=$vm|s$ | where len(vm_key)>0 AND len(observed_state)>0 AND status="success" | sort 0 - _time - event_id | dedup vm_key | table _time vcenter vm_name vm_id observed_state user identity_quality
